summary: Code review verification of camera/game-UI layout fix across DrawGame, FeudGame, and UnoGame. All three games implement the required layout: TOP = [CAMERA 1] [CAMERA 2], BELOW = [GAME UI]. Metadata (username/score) is correctly positioned under each respective camera. Desktop cameras are wide (not square). Mobile layouts stack cameras vertically with game UI below. Live multiplayer testing not possible in single-session environment.

FeudGame.jsx: Camera cards at top (lines 283-348) with flex-col sm:flex-row. Metadata directly under each camera (lines 310-314, 342-346). Game UI (round info, question, answers) below (lines 350-439). Desktop cameras: w-44 h-[5.75rem] (wide).

UnoGame.jsx: Both cameras in top section (lines 591-660) with flexDirection: isDesktop ? 'row' : 'column'. Metadata under each camera (lines 654-657). Game UI (cards, draw pile, turn indicator) below (lines 662-851). Desktop cameras: 240x104px (2.3:1 ratio, wide).
All three games use isDesktop state for responsive layout switching
Mobile layouts correctly stack cameras vertically (flex-col) with game UI fully visible below
